comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: Similar to the other PR, I wouldn't bother with tests in the `pydantic-core` test suite now that we can have them in the pydantic `tests` directory (as you already have added in this PR). Happy to just drop the additions to this file.

subsequent_commits.message: Fix link to model_dump method in fields.md
Update computed_field decorator syntax in documentation
Fix formatting in fields.md regarding @property usage

ambiguous_rewritten_commits.message: Support exclude if in computed fields
